stemMd: A drawer contains 8 left-hand and 8 right-hand gloves. Without looking, what is the minimum number that must be taken to guarantee at least one left and one right glove?
explanationMd: In the worst case the first eight are all left-hand or all right-hand gloves. The ninth must be of the other type, guaranteeing a pair. This is a worst-case question, not an average probability.

distractorRationale.b: All eight could come from one handedness.
distractorRationale.d: Nine already guarantees a glove of the other handedness.
distractorRationale.a: The two gloves could have the same handedness.
